summary.text: Jeff Holy is a Republican member of the Washington State Senate representing District 6, where he took office in 2019, and he is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 6, Position 2, in the state House from 2013 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Holy served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2013 to 2019 before moving to the Senate in 2019.
For 2023-2024 his Senate committee assignments were Health & Long Term Care, College and Workforce Development, Transportation, and the Joint Higher Education Committee.
